subject: Merry Christmas from Louis
preview: The baby in the manger grew up and showed us how to live.
linkText: 15 Lessons From the Life of Jesus

blocks.text: I am so glad you are here, and I did not want today to pass without saying that to you.
Today the whole world slows down, at least for a moment, to remember a baby in a manger.
He walked real roads. He met real people. And He lived out every word He taught.
🤍 He stopped for a blind beggar the whole crowd wanted to skip.
🤍 He knelt and washed His disciples' feet.
🤍 He prayed for the very men who nailed Him to the cross.
Here is what I want you to hold onto today.
Jesus did not just teach love. He lived it, all the way to the cross.
"Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do."
The same Jesus we celebrate today is the One who shows us how to live tomorrow.
So I put together fifteen real moments from the Gospels, each with the chapter and verse, so you can read them for yourself.
Pick just one this week and ask God to help you live it.

closing: It is completely free, just like everything else inside Bible Buddy. Merry Christmas.
